definition: Reproducible id assigned by DataIngestPipeline: '<dataset_source>-<original_split>-<row index>'.
Which corpus this row came from: 'atcosim' or 'atc-asr-dataset'.
The split as originally published by the source, before this project's own resplit.
This project's own train/validation/test split (see DataIngestPipeline._resplit).
The publisher's own row id, where available (atc-asr-dataset only; null for atcosim). Not used for joins/dedup -- `utterance_id`/`audio_checksum` are canonical for that.
Original filename of the row's audio clip.
sha1 of the decoded waveform's bytes; canonical audio-identity key for dedup.
None if the row's audio decoded cleanly; the exception message otherwise.
Raw transcript text as published by the source.
Lowercased, whitespace/punctuation-normalized transcript; canonical text-identity key for dedup.
Audio duration in seconds, from the decoded waveform.
Audio sample rate in Hz after resampling (see DataIngestPipeline.target_sample_rate); 0 for a corrupt row.
Whitespace-delimited token count of `transcript`.
Character count of `transcript`.
word_count / (duration_sec / 60); NaN if duration_sec is non-positive.
Count of ATC numeral-word tokens in `transcript_normalized` (see preprocessing.vocab).
Count of ATC command-verb tokens in `transcript_normalized`; a proxy pending real NER (deferred).
Count of callsign-like token runs in `transcript_normalized`; a proxy pending real NER (deferred).
Mean per-frame RMS amplitude (unitless, waveform in [-1, 1]); loudness proxy.
Percent of the clip librosa.effects.split(top_db=30) marks as below-threshold.
P95-P10 gap of per-frame RMS-in-dB; a heuristic dynamic-range proxy, NOT a physical SNR measurement -- comparative use only.
Mean per-frame zero-crossing rate; noisiness/unvoiced-speech proxy.
Mean per-frame amplitude-weighted mean frequency (Hz); 'brightness'.
Mean per-frame amplitude-weighted frequency spread (Hz).
ISO-8601 recording timestamp parsed from the filename, where the source's filenames embed one; null otherwise (structural, not missing data -- see DataIngestPipeline._parse_recorded_at).
True if `transcript_normalized` recurs across 2+ rows with *different* audio content (expected fixed ATC phraseology; never dropped -- see preprocessing.quality).
How many rows (post-cleaning) share this row's `transcript_normalized`.
